fact: The article says Togo's SIGE adds DHIS2 on top of CSPro-based statistical infrastructure, with StatEduc used for the annual school census.

Togo's education ministry processes annual census data through StatEduc, with DHIS2 integrated to process it and provide information products to subnational levels, per the implementing researchers and ministry staff.

The Ministry of Primary, Secondary, Technical Education, with Norad, GPE KIX and HISP WCA support, is piloting DHIS2 alongside the existing StatEduc application, which continues as the data-collection tool; the page gives national scale since 2019.

fact: HISP WCA, with GPE KIX and Norad, built a DHIS2-based education management information system (SIGE) for Togo's education ministry, implemented in 2021 in interoperability with StatEduc and described as currently under review by the ministry.
